title: passiflora foetida var. orinocensis
intro: Passiflora foetida var. orinocensis, commonly known as the Yellow Passion Flower or Yellow Passion Vine, is a plant species belonging to the Passifloraceae family. It is a woody vine native to South America, and its medicinal properties have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Passiflora foetida var. orinocensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative and antispasmodic effects.
